avis.texte: Feel like it was doing something good and working magic until i started breaking out im still working on my face getting back right. The texture is great, the feel after is hydrating choose you oily so i needed to follow up with another cleanser to feel clean
Love how it feels, light, almost scentless, gives immediate smooth skin feel. Can use it around eyes to remove makeup with no irritation.
I've bought this cleanser multiple times - love it and appreciate the new opening, it's easier to use!

avis.titre: I LOVE that you can barely smell the scent
avis.texte: I LOVE that you can barely smell the scent. The jelly texture feels really nice on my skin and cleanses it well. It hasn't been long using this cleanser but I think its breaking me up. Though I'm going to keep on using it to find out if it is or no. Overall I love this cleanser but i think its breaking me out.
Love it! Wish it foamed up a little but overall I love the ingredients and quality. Would purchase again!

So I use this and the cream cleanser that the brand makes. I love both. This is the best option when I'm wearing waterproof makeup. It comes out a gel but them turns milky once water hits it. If you have oily skin might be too much but for normal to dry its the bomb

avis.titre: Soft skin, clear face mad hippie glow
avis.texte: This product has changed my skin care routine and I couldn't be happier with the results. Thank you Mad Hippie

I feel like this face wash doesn't really get my face clean. It feels like there's a film leftover. And when I use toner on a cotton pad after washing, it appears much dirtier than when i use my other cleansers. 3 stars because it doesn't dry my face out, and it has clean ingredients.

If you suffer from dry skin this cleanser is the right move. My skin barely even needs a moisturizer after I used it. If you have oily skin it might be too much but for those with dry skin its a dream.
If you wear makeup but also have dry skin then this is the best cleanser out there. I love the smell and watching it go from a gel to milk when I add water. So glad I can now get this at ulta.

avis.titre: If you have dry skin - this is it!
avis.texte: I have very dry skin and have been searching for a cleanser that will take off my makeup without stripping my skin. This is my new holy grail! My skin is so frickin' soft after use that I just love it. If you have oily skin, it might be too much for you, but for anyone with dry skin get it!
Smell is super plastic-y and it made my face break out so bad after use. It also feels like it clogged my pores and didn't clean my face at all.

Efficient at breaking down long wearng makeup. Spritz water onto my face to emulsify it. Then wipe off with a damp washcloth. Face is soft and smooth. I don't even need a second cleanse. This has been my holy grail cleanser for a couple of years now.
At first loved this cleanser. After a week of using it my face randomly swelled up and was very itchy. I had to take zyrtec and benadryl to calm the swelling. 0/10. Do not recommend.
As a double cleanse, this felt very light after the Cream Cleanser, but I still like all the benefits of the cleanser for the face. Great product!

I have very dry flakey skin on my face and this works so well to exfoliate it with just my fingers. I hate using anything with texture since my skin is so sensitive and this is perfect. I've used the cream cleanser in the past and that worked pretty well, but the jelly cleanser is top tier :)
The scent is like perfume and the lid isn't my favorite. It's very gentle though but didn't feel strong enough for my skin needs.

avis.titre: Truly does clean with NO foam!
avis.texte: Not sure why people are saying this leaves a film on their face... This leaves absolutely NO film on the skin. Unless the product was expired, perhaps. It transforms into a milk once applied to the skin, so it's very light with no foam. It has a very light rose and lime smell. It did NOT break me out at all. However, lime oil can be an acne or dermatitis trigger for many people, so keep that in mind. I have super sensitive skin and I had NO acne flare ups which was incredible.
I hughly recommend this face wash. I have struggled wifh acne and i couldnt find anyhting that cleared my skin up, but this did!

avis.titre: Super moisturizing and takes off makeup
avis.texte: This product turns from a gel to a milkk when you add water. Its super hydrating but also does a great job taking off makeup. I believe it would be categorized as an oil cleanse as that's what it seems to be mainly made of. i love the consistency and how it makes my skin feel after using.

I love this product and it leaves my skin soft and clean but the packaging makes a big mess on my counter. The cleanser leaks out of the press button at the bottom and it is overall, hard to dispense the product as the tube gets lower. It would be great if you offered this product in a pump bottle like the cream cleanser.

I love this product and it leaves my skin soft and clean but the packaging makes a big mess on my counter. The cleanser leaks out of the press button at the bottom and it is overall, hard to dispense the product as the tube gets lower. It would be great if you offered this product in a pump bottle like the cream cleanser.

i love this cleanser so much! i have horribly dry skin and this feels so nice to rub in i dont even wanna wash it off 😭 and i love the way it makes my skin feel in the morning. my only complaint is that i really miss the old packaging design < /3

I love this face wash! I've recently had a major skin change and everything is drying my face out. I've always loved a cream cleanser, so I was a little skeptical about the jelly. It feels like heaven after I'm done. I've used the MH cream cleanser in the past and like it for the most part but it wasn't my favorite but it did a decent job. This one is way better!

Love the jelly texture!! And i love the smell! It it has high ratings for the clean apps for ingredients! And it makes my skin feel good! I love mad hippie products. I do miss their old packaging, it was more fun. Lol.

avis.titre: On repeat for this combo skin girlie!
avis.texte: I started using this product when I was pregnant and haven't stopped for over a year. The rose scent is the hero, but it is very subtle for anyone sensitive to smells. I use it daily in the shower for my face, and it helps my skin feel supple and protected after washing off compared to other washes that leave my skin feeling tight.

avis.titre: On repeat for this combo skin girlie!
avis.texte: I started using this product when I was pregnant and haven't stopped for over a year. The rose scent is the hero, but it is very subtle for anyone sensitive to smells. I use it daily in the shower for my face, and it helps my skin feel supple and protected after washing off compared to other washes that leave my skin feeling tight.

Even if I think I want to try something else, it's next to impossible after only a day of not using it. My face hates me after and I go back to using this. The reason I always think I want to switch is the one downfall to this product which is the packaging. The cap starts out great but toward the end of the tube the product will start leaking out the back side of the flip cap. It's also difficult to get the last bits of the product out of the tube when it's almost finished. Keeps my face soft, acne free, moisturized and removes my makeup. Even stubborn eye makeup. I don't experience any allergy issues with my sensitive combo skin with this cleanser. Leaves me glowing naturally, I don't even wear any foundation, blush, highlighter. I have tried tons of facial cleansers and nothing else comes close. Thank you for his facial cleanser! I use this with the Face Cream and MicroDermabrasion Facial 2x's weekly. I like to keep things simple!

I like to keep things simple!

I picked this up since I was out of my gentle facial cleanser (it was on sale). I have dry skin, so I found this ridiculously hydrating. Some people say it leaves a film (the ppl with oily skin), but it made my skin feel firmly hydrated, which was a first for me, since other hydrating cleansers never have left me feeling THIS hydrated. it comes out as a thicc jelly, which turns liquidy milky when mixed with water. it won't foam, but just wash for 30 seconds like the directions say, and it does its magic. Washing it off was odd, because there wasn't much to wash away since your skin absorbs quite a bit of it, and there is no lather to wash away either. I love that there are some skincare actives that are in the formula, that I don't have in my basic routine. So it makes it even better for me! (resveratrol is so under rated). I used to adore the daily moisturizer, but ditched it last year because of how similar my serum was to it, and the serum was cheaper. I didn't realize how much I missed mad hippie tho! 💖 The jelly is better than the cream cleanser, that just felt like lotion for your face. This one feels like it actually cleans my skin! Worth a shot for the dry skin gang ✨

I absolutely love this face wash it does everything makes my face feel nice and clean and takes my makeup off. I love that it's a clean product and doesn't give me blemishes at all on my face. Please don't change this product or take it off the market.

I absolutely love this face wash it does everything makes my face feel nice and clean and takes my makeup off. I love that it's a clean product and doesn't give me blemishes at all on my face. Please don't change this product or take it off the market.

I was in the market for a new cleanser and saw this was new at my local Mom's Organic Market. Wow. This was exactly what I have been looking for in a cleanser. I use it morning and night first on dry skin. It has the perfect slip to do a nice facial massage. Then I add some water and wash it off with a cloth. It's effective at cleansing my face without it feeling dry or stripped of moisture. Please never stop making this!!!

I was in the market for a new cleanser and saw this was new at my local Mom's Organic Market. Wow. This was exactly what I have been looking for in a cleanser. I use it morning and night first on dry skin. It has the perfect slip to do a nice facial massage. Then I add some water and wash it off with a cloth. It's effective at cleansing my face without it feeling dry or stripped of moisture. Please never stop making this!!!
I love the feel of this face wash. A little goes a long way. After a couple of days I noticed a huge difference in how my skin felt and looked. Pores reduced, black heads gone

I understand other peoples comments about this face wash, but I have been loving it. I have acne with rosacea and this cleanser has a load of rosacea friendly ingredients that doesnt trigger a flare up. I WILL say that this is not a cleanser that really foams up. If you want a foamy, Cerave like cleanser this is not that texture. It is definitely more a milk-like texture. Also i use this as my second cleanser when I double cleanse, i dont use it for removing makeup etc. I would recommend a cleansing balm beforehand as I dont think this product is strong enough to truly remove heavy makeup.
I usually love Mad Hippie products and decided to try the Jelly Cleanser. It leaves your face feeling like there is a film of product on it after cleansing. Not for me.

Ive been using this for about a month!! Im planning on buying ny second bottle. I have oily acne prone skin and this doesnt seem to break me out at all. It doesnt really foam because it is more of an oil to milk cleanser but it keeps my skin super hydrated!

If you have dry skin like me, this is a godsend. My skins so soft after i use it. I use a little of the hippie night cream after and my skin feels butter soft - which is amazing for someone in their early 50s.

avis.titre: Excellent for daily morning and evening use!
avis.texte: LOVE this cleanser!!! I love the way my skin feels after being double cleansed before bed. This one here is a gem! A double cleanse definitely removes all end of day dirt, makeup, and sunscreens. The key for me is to rub and work into the skin for 30-60 seconds, then wipe off with a face wash cloth (I like to use micro fiber cloths for exfoliating), then repeat. Apply your serums, toner, and moisturizer and just love the way your skin feels so clean, refreshed, and hydrated! A must for normal skin in my opinion!!! In the am, just a single cleanse is good, followed by serums, toner, moisturizer, and sunscreen.

Over the last couple of months, I switch to mad hippie products after always spending a bomb on prescription and or 'high end' brands my skin never seemed to get clear for any length of time, and I always felt dry no matter how many cream serums or moisturizers i used after reading so many positive reviews, I made the change over and couldn't be happier. My skin always feels moisturized, and my breakouts have definitely Eased; I live between two dry climates so to be able to find a skin care regimen that works no matter where I am is great and I don't have to spend a fortune to have nice skin anymore

avis.titre: more of a jelly to milk
avis.texte: cons: turns milky when applied to wet skin. does not leave a true clean feeling. made me breakout and is not to be used removing eyey makeup as it makes eyes sensitive pros: very light and non scented.
This product has made my skin amazing! Been using it Twice a day. Please keep it going and don't change the ingredients as it has saved my skin! I love how hydrating and light the formula is

For my active girls who need simple skincare! Recent Division 1 athlete who is active every day - this is great! - skin is soft - hydrating - gentle - removes makeup It leaves my face feeling hydrated and clean. I sometimes pair this with the oil cleanser when I double wash. I highly recommend!

avis.titre: Unexpected "meet cute" that's left me MADly in LOVE!!!
avis.texte: I first met this facial cleanser in a sample that came with another purchase and I must say...I was so happy for this brief introduction! I am familiar with (and use) a lot of high-end/luxury skincare products and this cleanser is right up there with the BEST (for a fraction of the price)! This cleanser feels so velvety to the touch. I love the texture. It leaves my skin feeling so incredible cleansed without stripping or face tightness. My skin looks and feels fresh, clean, and so hydrated afterwards. I actually don't want to put any other product on after I cleanse my face with this wash. I am one happy camper and now officially MAD (about) HIPPIE. < 3

I love Mad Hippie products and was excited to try this cleanser. I love the ingredients and the texture of this cleanser but it doesn't rinse well and feels like it leaves a slight film on my skin after rinsing.
This face wash leaves my skin beautiful. I suffer from acne and this has drastically diminished my pores and acne! Love it please keep these ingredients and continue this power wash!
You only need to use a tiny dot. This cleanser is luxurious, because of how it feels and smells. Most importantly, it makes my skin feel like a baby.

I'll start with the good. The packaging is pretty and made from sustainable materials. Easy to use tube that you don't need to twist open with wet hands is great. It starts out smelling pleasant (like lemons and honey) but it's nice fragrance is short lived and quickly changes to something not so nice, lingering on the skin for the next foreseeable future. You have to use a LOT to remove your makeup. The first time I tried it required a second cleaning because there was so much makeup left behind…and I don't wear that much but I did have sparkly eyshadow. It leaves an awful film over your eyes and skin. I read a couple reviews saying skin felt and looked great after a week or two but i dont think I'm strong enough to hold out for that.

Finally a cleanser that leaves my skin clean, fresh AND moisturized. Most everything else feels too thin or too heavy. I love the weight, scent and quality of this gentle yet effective product. Thank you!

avis.titre: Not my fave but not bad.
avis.texte: I'm 56 with combination/oily skin. I always do a patch test before I put something on my face. Once I determined I would not have a reaction to it, I gave it a proper trial. A whole bottle later, this is my review. It worked ok with my morning and night routine. It felt odd because it didnt foam but my face felt clean but not stripped. The advert is correct, it feels mildly acidic. The thing I didn't like about it was after a few days I felt like I needed to do a physical exfoliation. The reason i gave it 4 stars is because it didnt improve my routine. It was just ok.

Like other reviews said, this left my face feeling even oilier than it was before, so i hated this in the beginning. However I'm loving it as a first step when I double cleanse. This is so good at getting all the makeup and sunscreen off my face without stripping it, plus I wear waterproof mascara a lot in the summer and this is so good at getting everything off without stinging my eyes at all! I can't even say that about makeup removers specifically meant for eyes. So if you bought this and don't like it as a primary cleanser, consider using it as a makeup remover, it works really well!
I have super sensitive, dry skin. Every single recommendation for sensitive skin broke me out so bad. After a day of using this my skin is glowing, hydrated and clear. 10/10

avis.titre: Hated it at first but now its my favorite cleanser.
avis.texte: I have oily acne prone skin and wear sunscreen daily. It gets sunscreen off but you will need additional makeup remover for waterproof makeup. When I first used this I hated it because it leaves a film behind, your face will not feel dry. But I couldn't return it so I thought I'd just use it as a morning cleanser. It made my skin so smooth, glowy, no breakouts, and plump! I realized this cleanser is still cleaning my face but without stripping my skin of all moisture. Now I use it night & day, I highly recommend drying off with a washcloth to wipe away any access oil.

avis.titre: Excellent product - just not right for me
avis.texte: This is a beautiful gel to milk texture that genuinely does melt makeup, oil, and gunk away! I have the kind of oily skin that doesn't break out, but is very self hydrating and this formulas was too oily for me. I had little white heads the second morning. That never happens! I liked the texture, the smell, and how easily it took off even mascara. My skin didn't feel fully clean after, even though I know that it cleaned. Again, I think it's just a little too awesome for my well oiled skin. I contacted customer service and Amy quickly responded that I might want to try the cream cleanser instead and she sent me a sample that is on its way! And I can return the Jelly Cleanser! Amazing! So impressed. I'm using the Vit. A and C serums and the hydrating sunscreen and I L O V E them!

I dont recommend for face. Im currently using this for my body (armpits, etcc...) i bought this for my face but it leaves a greasg film and isnt good. Doesnt help my acne or with pores. Barely cleans and you will feel like the product is still on you after you wash. Smells really nice tho so i use for my body now.

I dont recommend for face. Im currently using this for my body (armpits, etcc...) i bought this for my face but it leaves a greasg film and isnt good. Doesnt help my acne or with pores. Barely cleans and you will feel like the product is still on you after you wash. Smells really nice tho so i use for my body now.
LOVE this cleanser & it's jelly like texture. I look forward to using it. Like to alternate with the cream cleanser after every few days.

I always thought cleansers we're not supposed to do anything special for your face like serums and moisturizers do… this cleanser does so much! And evens my skin tone, gives me a nice glow, and definitely moisturize my face all while cleasing it. Doesnt strip. I loge this stuff
Overall it is a great cleanser but I would change the bottle or container it's in because water is very easy to get in through the opening.
This is so hydrating and gentle on my dry sensitive skin. My skin feels so good and not stripped at all. Will definitely buy again.

avis.titre: Did the opposite of what it is supposed to do to my skin
avis.texte: The scent is way to strong, I have combination skin a d this dried it out terribly and made me break out sadly. I really wanted to love it but it wasn't my favorite at all.

I really needed a cleanser bc the one I had I had run out and I love Tula cleanser but I wanted to try something new and so I thought this one would be fine bc I like jelly cleansers and I've washed my face with this cleanser 3 times and every time I finished rinsing it off my face felt oily and sticky and I would try to wash that of but it just wouldn'. This product feels like vaseline same texture and when you put it on the skin same thing I don't recommend unless you like a thick cleanser that will give you trouble to take it off then go for it but I really didn't like it. I'll be buying my Tula product forever now.
My complain with this jelly cleanser is the residue that was left on my face after using. Skin did not feel clean. It might not be suitable for my combo skin type.

I was using La Roche-Posay's Effaclar, but I went cruelty free so I needed a replacement. Decided to give this a try and I love it! I'm typically not a fan of scents, but the cleanser has a faint scent of chamomile which I actually enjoy, it doesn't last which is good too. Some people think you need the "foam" as proof of the cleanser actually "cleansing", but that isn't really true. This took away all the oil & dirt my t-zone accumulated during the day, while also keeping my dry cheeks clean & hydrated. I only wish the container was bigger lol

All time favorite cleanser! I am so stoked on this and will recommend to anyone. I think it's a pretty good bang for your buck too. I have been using this cleanser for 5 months now, and my skin has never been more clear. At first I was still getting a few pimples, but seriously not even one pimple in the last 3 months. I have paired this with the vitamin C and A serum along with the day moisturizer. I haven't even gotten hormonal acne. Obsessed.
A friend gifted me this cleanser and I'm happy with it. It doesn't overstrip your skin and it's good for the Spring, summer and fall. If you have harsh winters, a creamier cleanser would be better.

I admit, I didn't love this at first. At first I thought it was too thick for my preference... however, after setting it aside for a bit and revisiting it, I definitely learned to appreciate it and every it does. It is a powerhouse of a product. Cleanses, removes makeup, and softens the skin all with the a faint scent that smells like the gorgeous cream cleanser. I'm so glad I gave it another try because it is powerfully effective.

avis.titre: Would Have Been a Great Replacement, But...
avis.texte: I tried this as a dupe to my Asarai gel cleanser and unfortunately it didn't work out for me. The 2 are similar and this face wash didn't irritate my skin, but I did notice some tiny bumps form after using this a few times (possibly caused by an allergic reaction to an ingredient). If not for that I probably would have kept it as my skin did feel soft and moisturized after. It is worth trying, especially if you do not have sensitive skin like me.
Removes makeup completely, very gentle on my sensitive skin. Easily rinses off. Leaves my face soft and clean, couldn't be more perfect! I have already placed another order.

i've never written a single review in my entire life but for this… wow. this removes makeup so well- it just disappears i don't even know where it goes. usually i have to double cleanse to get all my makeup off but not with this one! I didn't have the highest expectations as i was comparing it to a different cleanser from mad hippie, but wow. it does leave a film on your face, but it is more so a hydrating oil type film and absorbs into skin quickly and feels amazing! it does not lather/foam, which would make it seem like it won't cleanse well, but it definitely does! i have combination (more oily) skin and pretty sensitive as well and i've had no problems with this. been using it for about two weeks now! i paired it with their moisturizer and it's a magnificent duo!!! i am obsessed! 😍

I do not wear make up, I have fairly clear combo/sensitive skin, I double cleanse. If this does not apply for you, skip my review. I love this cleanser as my second in command after the MH cleansing oil. It's light, light lather, smells great. The only con in the bottle, not a fan. Would like to see it in a pump bottle like the cream cleanser.

avis.titre: I have gone through an entire tube. Here's my review.
avis.texte: I am pretty minimal when it comes to makeup, I put on tinted foundation and medium coverage concealer with blush, bronzer and a light fill to the brows. I don't usually wear mascara. I find this jelly cleanser to be perfect for me. It doesn't foam, but it turns milky when mixed with water. I apply it to my my wet face and rub in circular motions all over, for about a minute, focusing on my t-zone. I rinse *well* with warm water and apply the rest of my Mad Hippie products. My skin has never been better. I find that my skin is ultra soft after use, non drying, not really fragrant. My face looks even and feels smooth. This cleanser is gentle yet I find it pretty effective at removing my makeup, since I haven't had a breakout since. I say this tube has lasted me over a month with continuous use, *mainly* in the evening. It is gentle enough & non drying to use in the morning if you need to! I usually just splash my face with water and apply the Vit. C Serum and Antioxidant Oil. Pretty good stuff. 10/10 recommend.

I absolutely love that this brand is sustainable as well as made from natural substances rather than harsh chemicals. I'm very health conscious and it's often hard to find a skincare product that is healthy but also works. I have sensitive skin and some skin texturing that I'm still working on improving so I love that this product helps my skin feel clean and nourished. Highly recommend!

This product is to die for! It comes out like honey, turns to milk when water is added, and leaves my skin buttery soft. I would leave my husband for this product...if I had to make a decision (hahaha...but don't tell him)

Love this cleanser so much!! It's great & not stripping to skin Only issue is the bottle w the snap cap it comes in. They need to change it to a pump or flip cap. The face wash always squeezes out the back of the snap cap & also makes it impossible to use all of it so a ton is wasted. I wish mad hippie would fix this

Okay, I'm not going to lie, I didn't expect this to be an extremely thorough cleanser. I haven't gone with a cleanser with an ingredient blend like this before. But, oh my goodness!!! It cleaned my face extremely thoroughly! My pore size has definitely been reduced with consistent use. It pairs really well with the AHA Peel, face cream, and nutrient mist!!!

This left an oily layer on my face that i could not rinse off which is odd considering it didn't remove any of my makeup. It didn't burn my eyes or anything crazy but i just don't understand who this was made for
Not a fan. Burned my eyes even though I thoroughly washed it off my face (nowhere near my eyes, mind you). It was hard to get out of the tube, and didn't do anything. Waste of money.
Just replaced my inkey list cleanser with this. Wasn't sure I'd like it but it leaves my face so beautifully soft and takes off all my makeup. Smells divine.
This is truly a clean product, and I love that, but the smell is, well, like fried donuts. So not my fav. I won't be buying again
Wonderful! I received a sample, and tried it this morning. I'm impressed with how soft and hydrated my skin feels. I now need to order a tube or two of this cleanser. Thank you Mad Hippie.

An underrated face wash! This is a great gentle cleanser with soothing ingredients. Was looking for something that didn't dry my skin out and tested this out. Surprisingly it leaves my skin really soft and hydrated! I have acne prone combination skin and it doesn't irritate my skin(been using it for two week now). I use this as my second cleanser after my makeup remover. Would recommend if you have sensitive, dry or combo skin and want a cleanser that has calming/hydrating ingredients that won't cause your skin to freak out.

I wasn't expecting this to soften my skin so much, really amazing. The scent of the cream cleanser is too medicinal-like, so I was wary of the scent of this jelly cleanser. I don't like the cream cleanser because of the scent. The scent of the jelly cleanser Is light, almost minty. In comparison, the oil cleanser's scent is floral/fruity and light as well. Both very pleasant for someone who Is VERY sensitive to scents. You have to use a lot of the jelly cleanser for it to get 'milky' when rubbing in with water. This and the oil cleanser are my favorites, they really do soften and cleanse the skin.

I love the way this cleanser makes my face feel after use. It is not drying and my face feels very clean and fresh. I have also used the Cream Cleanser and they are equally as good. The Jelly Cleanser is easier to travel with. Love them both!

avis.titre: Interesting but totally worth the buy
avis.texte: So I recently purchased this after my Glossier Milky Jelly Cleanser ran out… I wanted a nice eco-friendly, clean, and transparent brand and product. Which was not Glossier, so I tried Map Hippie Jelly cleanser instead hoping it would be similar. I would say it's equivalent if not better aside from a few things. 1) It does leave a kind of "film" right after you wash. I washed my face in the shower with a Foreo brush and I could feel it when I stepped out. BUT After I let my face dry my face absorbed all of it and it felt so clean and soft. glossier tended to dry my face out… so that's a positive but a little different. 2) It does have the honey consistency but it's a little thinner than honey. Glossier was a little more runny but this one was pretty good. Lastly it helped quite a bit with redness and dry skin in winter. Looking forward to seeing how it works out for me. I have combo skin and I'm acne prone.
This is the perfect cleanser for my dry skin. My skin actually feels more hydrated after using it. It's absolutely my fav!

I was nervous I wouldn't like it because I wasn't overly fond of the cream cleanser scent but this is great! I usually use a foaming cleanser so it's an adjustment but I love it how it makes my skin feel after I rinse. Definitely worth it!

This is a jelly to milk cleanser, and I love the texture and feel on my skin. It didn't cause me any breakouts or sensitivity and I have VERY acne prone sensitive skin. The only problem is, it doesn't actually cleanse my skin. It's almost like rubbing in an oil. I never use water proof mascara, and all this cleanser did was move around my mascara and made it stick to my skin. I had to use a different cleanser to actually get it off my cheeks. I honestly don't know if it's removing my SPF either. Just in case I've been double cleansing with it, but I don't think I will repurchase.
This cleanser doesnt cleanse, doesnt foam, doesnt do anything except irritate my skin and cause breakouts. i love Mad Hippie sunscreen but this is juust awful.

It took me a few days to make up my mind regarding the consistency, but I love it! This does not make my skin feel tight after using. My face feels clean, soft and smooth! I am not sure how to describe the smell. It is very faint and fresh! I will definitely repurchase!

Amazing! I was very excited to try this cleanser, mainly because I own the whole line...but, the way it cleanses and leaves my skin is amazing. Is just another goodie that's definitely going in my routine; now, I would have to alternate between this cleanser and the cream cleanser. I love this line, makes my skin look and feel like I have never seen it before. Thank you guys
Works wonders for my breakout prone face. Ordering more even though I'm not finished with my first one, because I don't want to dare run out! I love EVERYTHING from this company.

This stuff is amazing! Smells delicious like flowers. The jelly gel transforms into a milky foam once you mix it with water. Cleans super well without being drying. My skin is left smooth, clean, and radiant. I love using this in the evening and the milk cleanser in the AM. Powerful combination. The bio resin tube it comes in is very pretty and easy to travel with.

Love the new cleanser. Bought it on whim, but it is wonderful. I love the original skin cleanser, but this really takes off the makeup and grime at the end of a long day at work. It really does turn milky and makes your skin feel amazing.

Oh. My. Word. I seriously love this cleanser! The cream cleanser is lovely, and the oil cleanser is my favorite night-time product, but this is amazing! I've never met a gel cleanser (or any cleanser) like this. A previous reviewer said it came out like honey and that is 100% correct..I was actually using honey as my morning cleanser prior to this. At the same time it literally melts off makeup! Currently using as my morning cleanse or step 2 in a double cleanse (or if I don't have time to oil-cleanse). Give it a try! You won't regret it. I always want to try new things (product junkie over here) but I always, ALWAYS come back to Mad Hippie.

My skin is so soft when I use this. My face feels clean without being tight or dry. It's worth noting that this does not foam up at all, which takes some getting used to, but it cleans wonderfully. My pores seem less congested, as well

avis.titre: Exactly what you've been waiting for!
avis.texte: Let's just say this is the cleanser you've been looking for! Takes makeup off in a snap and leaves skin feeling hydrated and super soft! I can't say enough good things about this cleanser! If it's not in your cart it should be! Love it!

It pains me to give mad hippie anything less than a 5 as a huge fan, but I was so disappointed with this cleanser. I had tried the cream cleanser and did not like the residue it left and how it just smeared around my makeup (I barely wear any, not a full face). I was hoping this would be more of a traditional cleanser but it didn't get any suds whatsoever and I could tell it was just smearing mascara and sweat all over my face. It felt incredibly moisturizing and left my skin feeling very soft, so perhaps if you double cleanse and have dry skin, this could be an option for you!
This cleanser is so cool! It turns to a cream once wet and leaves your skin so soft to the touch. My new go-to cleanser!

WOW!! That's all I can say. This is kind of like a gel cleanser, but a whole new realm. When it comes out it's like honey, but when you add water to it, it magically becomes creamy! It leaves my skin so soft and works wonders taking off makeup! I guess you could say I'm in love!
